messages:
aisha: Heads up — multiple customers saw SSO login failures and SCIM provisioning gaps after yesterday's KMS alias swap.
danny: are we seeing INVALID_KEY or UNKNOWN_KID errors?
aisha: both. Our SAML consumer shows 'unknown kid' when validating assertion encryption, while KMS audit shows successful decrypts for the new key but some requests still target the old alias.
priya: could be a race between alias update and IdP metadata caching. If SP metadata still references the old kid we get mismatch.
marco: do we log incoming assertion kid? we should correlate kid -> KMS audit entry.
eng-sre: KMS audit export: ~230 'NO_SUCH_KEY' for projects/.../ri-key-old between 2026-05-10T22:10Z-22:18Z, and ~1.4k 'ACCESS_DENIED' for ri-key-new where context didn't match.
aisha: maybe some IdP instances still encrypt with the old key while the old key was disabled during rotate.
danny: mitigation: re-enable old key for a short window and add a compatibility handler to accept either kid for decryption while we notify customers to refresh metadata.
priya: RBAC concern: partial SCIM creates left service accounts without role assignments. need a reconciler to find accounts created locally but missing grants and avoid auto-granting until identity verified.
marco: I'll add a reconciler job that checks scim_events where created_local=true && provisioned_remote=false and either retries or flags for manual review if >24h.
eng-sre: re-enabling old key requires security approval; vuln triage flagged key reuse risk.
danny: tradeoff: re-enable old key in decrypt-only mode (no encrypt), strict logging, and a 30-minute expiry window.
aisha: plan: 1) enable old-key decrypt-only window (30m) behind flag, 2) run reconciler to requeue SCIM events and list orphans, 3) notify IdP vendors/customers to refresh metadata and clear caches, 4) postmortem + add e2e test for alias swap.
priya: I'll export audit logs for 22:05-22:20Z focusing on RBAC changes and any role grants tied to those service accounts.
marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4222 — kid fallback shim + reconciler stub; feature flag 'saml.kid_compat' default off.
eng-sre: will monitor scim_backlog, orphan_account_count, kms_no_such_key_count and kms_access_denied_count during deploy.
okta-bot: Incident 2026-05-10-92 created: SAML KID mismatch after key alias swap — Okta team notified.
aisha: vuln triage note: Danny, can you own the security assessment for re-enabling old-key decrypt-only?
danny: on it. will scope risk and propose compensating controls: limited ttl, decrypt-only IAM binding, tight audit retention.
priya: thanks. tagging @marco for reconciler PR review. aiming for deploy in ~45m.
marco: reviewing now. :thumbsup:
